title: Country Gospel
style: Upbeat gospel bluegrass style, male lead vocal, energetic and joyful, fast tempo, acoustic instrumentation with frequent instrumental solos including banjo, fiddle, mandolin, and acoustic guitar, upright bass driving rhythm, less drum, add harmonica and spoons, Appalachian revival feel, storytelling lyrics based on the King James Version Bible, martyrdom and gospel mission theme, strong harmony choruses, celebratory and foot-stomping
lyrics:
Verse 1 (Fast, Joyful Drive)
He stood before the council
With fire in his eyes
Spoke of Abraham and Moses
Pointed straight to Christ
They couldn’t stand the wisdom
That the Spirit gave
Every word cut deeper
Like a stone already raised

Chorus
Keep preaching, Stephen
Don’t you hold it back
From the prophets to the promise
To the cross where Jesus died
Though the crowd grew angry
And they stopped their ears that day
The truth he spoke kept marching on
Keep preaching, Stephen

Instrumental Break – Banjo Solo
(8 bars – driving and joyful)

Verse 2 (Build / Bold)
He told them how their fathers
Resisted Heaven’s call
Built the temple with their hands
But missed the Lord of all
They took the Just One, killed the Christ
Rejected God’s own Son
The words rang out like thunder
Before the stones had come

Chorus
Keep preaching, Stephen
Let the heavens hear
You didn’t speak in your own strength
The Holy Ghost was near
They ground their teeth in fury
As the truth lit up the way
But every word he preached that day
Still lives today

Instrumental Break – Fiddle & Mandolin Trade
(12–16 bars – fiddle lead → mandolin response)

Verse 3 (Triumphant / Awe)
He lifted up his eyes and said
“I see the heavens wide
The Son of Man is standing
At the Father’s side”
They rushed him out, they threw their stones
But mercy filled his breath
He prayed forgiveness for his foes
And bowed his head in death

Bridge (Half-Time / Emotional Lift)
We were standing there that moment
When the stones fell to the ground
But what they meant to silence him
Just made the gospel louder now

Instrumental Break – Guitar Solo
(8 bars – celebratory and hopeful)

Final Chorus (Big / Group Harmony)
Keep preaching, Stephen
Your voice is not gone
From Jerusalem to the nations
Your message carries on
What they tried to bury
God used to light the way
Now we’ll take the truth you died for
And preach it just the same

Outro (Fast Tag / Joyful)
He saw the glory...
Now we’ll tell the story—
Keep preaching, Stephen!

(End with full-band bluegrass hit)
